parsed.answer: Yes, you can. NW1004 is still "In transit", so its address can be changed free of charge until it reaches "Out for delivery". The change must stay within the same country, and Coimbra is in Portugal, so that's fine. Please make the change soon, because after the parcel is out for delivery the address can no longer be changed.
